description: A script for compiling .idl files into Blink V8 bindings, including code generation and command-line parsing.

classes.name: IdlCompiler
classes.description: An abstract class for compiling IDL files into code, handling reading IDL definitions and invoking code generators.

methods.name: parse_options
methods.description: Parses command-line options and returns options and input filename.

methods.name: compile_and_write
methods.description: Reads IDL definitions and writes generated code files.

methods.name: generate_bindings
methods.description: Generates code bindings from IDL files using specified code generator.

methods.name: generate_dictionary_impl
methods.description: Generates dictionary implementation code from IDL files.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point to execute the script.
